additional_info.subject: RE: ID0415963-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/P0 312567479/04] replace the converter CRM:02678000040
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0415963 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Please refer below troubleshooting steps:
Check for any loose connections in the power cables or CAN communication cables of the converter and measure the voltage across them using a multimeter. Additionally, check the resistance across the CAN communication cables.
Verify the status of the power converter display—whether it is in the OFF or ON state.
Consider swapping the power converter with a functional one. If the error flag shifts to the replaced unit, it suggests that the original converter may be faulty.
If all the steps have been performed and the power converter is still found to be faulty, we recommend replacing it, as rework is not feasible.
Please refer the MLFB details for ordering the converter: 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 → Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
Additionally, you may refer the attached troubleshooting document.
Please ensure electrical safety and adhere to PPE guidelines.
